retrieved_context: Christopher Oscar Peña: Christopher Oscar Peña is a playwright, screenwright, actor and educator who resides in New York City.  He teaches theater at NYU's Tisch School of Arts and is a member of the Playwrights Unit at Goodman Theatre in Chicago.  He also has had work commissioned by Yale Repertory Theatre.  Peña is the co-writer of the Golden Globe nominated TV series, Jane the Virgin and was on the "Future Broadway Power List," by Backstage (magazine) in 2014.
Scott Christopher: Scott Christopher (born January 13, 1967) is an American film and television actor known for his roles in "The Best Two Years" and "Granite Flats".

Oscar and Lucinda (film): Oscar and Lucinda is a 1997 British-Australian-American romantic drama film directed by Gillian Armstrong and starring Cate Blanchett, Ralph Fiennes, Ciarán Hinds and Tom Wilkinson.  It is based on the 1988 Booker Prize-winning novel "Oscar and Lucinda" by Peter Carey.  In March 1998, the film was nominated at the Academy Awards for the Best Costume Design.
